Lina (CS): quick sync 1 HelixCare's renewal packet flagged missing: (1) confirmed tenant isolation diagram, (2) embeddings retention policy, (3) DPA excerpt for subprocessors. They want a single zip for compliance upload by Fri PST.
Ravi (Security): I can produce a simplified tenant isolation PNG + one-paragraph explainer. Question: should we include network ACLs or just logical boundaries?
Evan (Infra): for this customer logical boundaries + KV separation + backup key provenance is enough. I'll add a short KMS exported key ledger snippet.
Priya (Solutions): I'll add a 2-line note about how embeddings are generated and stored. default retention is 90d for hosted; Dedicated customers can request BYOK/never-store per contract.
Nora (Legal): I'll paste a copy-paste friendly DPA blurb re: subprocessors and logging locations. Make sure it's non-contracting language.
Jules (HelixCare): fyi our compliance team prefers to see explicit retention values for derivative data (embeddings) and a statement on ability to delete embeddings on request. can you confirm delete path?
Ravi (Security): confirm deletion flow: customer requests -> ticket created -> embeddings invalidated in cache + background job deletes from embeddings store within 48h (log entry recorded). I'll write the 1-sentence deletion path.
Lina (CS): good. plan: everyone drop a single artifact into /onboarding/renewals/HelixCare/renewal-2026-evidence by Thu 23:59 PT. I will assemble and do a gap check Fri AM, then upload zip.
OnboardBot: Reminder set 1 /onboarding/renewals/HelixCare/renewal-2026-evidence (due 2026-04-02T06:59:00Z). Assigned: Ravi, Evan, Priya.
Priya (Solutions): uploading: "embeddings-retention.md" (2 lines + config path: `services/embeddings/config.retention_days=90`) and a note about opt-out flags. Link: https://rwd.example.com/docs/embeddings/retention#helixcare
Evan (Infra): uploaded: "kms-provenance.txt" (list of backup snapshots + CMKs per tenancy).
Ravi (Security): uploaded: "tenant-isolation.png" and "deletion-flow.txt" (deletion path + log reference ID schema).
Nora (Legal): uploaded: "dpa-excerpt-for-helixcare.txt" 1 includes subprocessors list + where audit logs are stored (EU logs in eu-logging cluster).
Jules (HelixCare): thanks team 1 one small follow-up: can you confirm whether embeddings are included in regular backups? we need that for their internal risk register.
Evan (Infra): short answer: embeddings store is excluded from nightly full DB backups; snapshots are taken for disaster recovery but are encrypted and tied to tenant CMKs. I'll add that note to kms-provenance.txt.
Lina (CS): gap check: all artifacts present. I'll assemble README with links, a one-page summary, and the zip. Uploading Fri 09:00 PT and sending Slack thread to Jules.
Jules (HelixCare): perfect, appreciate the quick turnaround :rocket:
